summary: Callaway scoring app: persist Calloway Chart Editor edits as the default values in browser localStorage.
architectural_notes: Persist Callaway Chart Editor configuration to browser localStorage and load it as the default on app start.

existing_features.title: When a user saves changes in the Callaway Chart Editor, persist the saved 9-hole and 18-hole grid charts as the new *default* chart values in localStorage, so that future loads and “Reset to Defaults” use those saved values instead of the hard-coded code defaults.

Update the Callaway chart persistence layer to support separate localStorage keys for (a) user-default grid charts and (b) the currently-active/edited grid charts, and update the runtime chart selection logic to fall back to the localStorage defaults before falling back to hard-coded defaults.

new_feature_requests.summary: Make edits from the Callaway Chart Editor become the default values stored in localStorage (persist and load as defaults).
